title: What Fear Does The Yogi Have?
summary: Forgiveness is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: To practice forgiveness is the true fast, good conduct and contentment; what fear does the Yogi have?
lifeApplication: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.
